row.body: The notebook has one page torn out and a route copy with a blank arrival box. A pencilled note asks whether the driver should wait or report the stop complete.
row.title: The page without a mark

sidecar.gloss: A route is marked complete without an arrival time.
sidecar.rival_reading: A research or delivery crew could have left an incomplete route book; the blank box does not show who was expected.
